Players Committee card image of [[Sabotage (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Target an opponent's non-superlaser weapon card. Draw destiny. Subtract 1 if your spy on table. Target lost if total destiny < target's destiny number. OR Cancel an attempt to use a [Permanent Weapon] weapon to target your spy (or any card with your spy).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/sabotage.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
